title: v1.0 Release: AI Data Center Tycoon
author: PurpleJelly_Custom
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/lr6ms2s9bd1h1.png?width=960&format=png&auto=webp&s=61859906cc77d4c56516a2458cabeb6d6c5485f0

I have made this AI Data Center Tycoon is a browser-based idle clicker about growing an AI company from nothing, a single machine in a garage, into something the size of Google or Anthropic. You manage two resources: **Compute** (FLOPS) and **Data** (model parameters). Both gate your progress, which means you can't just buy your way to the top with hardware alone. You need the data to train on, too.

Find it in Itch.io: [AI-data-center-tycoon](https://purplejelly.itch.io/ai-data-center-tycoon)

It's free and it runs in your browser.

comments.author: gravenguy
comments.body:
Such an obvious poor-quality spin off my man.  At least change the theme up a bit.  

I am glad that you think it was a good enough idea to create a new version of, just don't be so obvious.

replies.author: PurpleJelly_Custom
replies.body:
Hey, thank you for your comment.

Just checked after seeing your comment and found the Data Center Tycoon game that I’m assuming you are referring to. I genuinely didn’t know that existed. I’ve just tried it though and it’s really nice 😊.
